args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks following the v2.3.1 production deploy. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified: service healthy in all regions, error rate 0.2%. v2.3.1 (and its staging rc) should be investigated before any redeploy attempt.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed:** Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the latest production release and was unhealthy; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollout verified.
3. **Confirmed recovery:** service is now healthy in all regions with a 0.2% error rate.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) describing the health check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0.

Note: v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so any attempt to redeploy it will require change-manager approval under organizational policy.
